query:
SELECT DISTINCT
  s.venue,
  s.scheduleDay,
  s.scheduleTime,
  COUNT(*) as student_count
FROM students s
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
  SELECT 1 FROM dojos d
  WHERE s.venue = d.name 
    AND s.scheduleDay = d.schedule_day 
    AND s.scheduleTime = d.schedule_time
)
GROUP BY s.venue, s.scheduleDay, s.scheduleTime
LIMIT 20;
